workload.seed_rule: (1000 + 17*rows + 7777*input_set) modulo 2**32; same seed for both source ranks
workload.generator: Unmodified CUDA ref::gen_input and ref::gen_outliers; identical generator and seed pairing to the performance artifact

bf16_nccl.label: BF16 NCCL
bf16_nccl.correctness_reference: Full output bitwise equal to BF16-RNE(FP32(x0)+FP32(x1)); signed-zero direct-add semantics. Error metrics still use the unrounded FP32 reference.

fp8_e4m3_ue8m0_group128.label: FP8 E4M3 + UE8M0, group128
fp8_e4m3_ue8m0_group128.scale_rule: e=max(-120,ceil(log2(amax/448))); scale=2**e; scale_code=e+127; zero group code7
fp8_e4m3_ue8m0_group128.arithmetic: E4M3 RNE source quantization; separate rank-ordered FP32 multiply/add with +0 seed; BF16 RNE output; no second FP8 quantization

mxfp8_e4m3_e8m0_group32_reference.rounding: E4M3 RNE with finite saturation; BF16 RNE
mxfp8_e4m3_e8m0_group32_reference.accumulation: separate FP32 multiply/add; +0 seed; source0 then source1

accuracy_method.reference: r_i=FP32_add_rn(FP32_add_rn(+0,float(x0_i)),float(x1_i)) for original BF16 inputs; no low-precision codec is applied to the reference.
accuracy_method.relative_l2: sqrt(mean(e_i**2)/mean(r_i**2)); if reference mean square is zero, use RMSE
accuracy_method.reduction_precision: FP32 tensor subtraction, squares and means in PyTorch; host square root. These are measured metrics, not an FP64 error recomputation.

aggregation: Each shape has three independent seeded inputs. Ranges are min/max of their full-output metrics; rank duplicates are retained for agreement evidence, not averaged. No pooling across shapes.

cpu_mxfp8.scope: CPU scale/codec reference checks; GPU casts require separate qualification

gpu_mxfp8_edge_checks.independent_reference: NumPy frexp and finite E4M3 codebook RNE
NumPy frexp and finite E4M3 codebook RNE

qualification.gpu_edge_scope: Nine complete group32 cases per rank: all +0, mixed signed zero, 448/450 threshold, 1, 2^-133, 2^-127, 2^-120, and 2^100; signed alternating values and cancellation. CPU scale coverage does not establish all-input GPU correctness.
qualification.mxfp8_independent_oracle_scope: 128 complete groups per seeded tensor; full-output finite, rank agreement and error metrics. No MXFP8 communication implementation or timing.

packaged_gpu_smoke.scope: Includes exact UE8M0 codec/wire checks, full-output frozen-baseline/eager/changed-graph equality, signed-zero/adversarial inputs, 12-phase triple-buffer wrap with alternating shapes and rank skew, and reuse stress.

source_hash_scope: Hashes identify measured source snapshots. Current published support files may contain later metadata-only privacy cleanup; no claim that every current support file is byte-identical. Generator, native reference, metric code and measured FP8 kernel hashes match the performance artifact.

caveats: Synthetic numerical error, not model or task accuracy; no serving or end-to-end speed claim.

The custom group128 format and standard group32 format use different scale floors and group sizes. These inputs can produce very similar errors; this does not establish equivalence for other distributions.
NCCL and NVFP4 are actual AllReduce outputs. MXFP8 group32 is a local GPU numerical reference using the documented round-up recipe; it has no AllReduce timing.
The scope is the tested finite seeded and adversarial inputs; BF16 extremes can overflow reconstruction or output.
